hero.description: A multiplayer Arabic game based on hidden roles, deception, alliances, and special abilities. Can you figure out who to trust?
hero.downloadNote: Download currently available on Android — iOS version coming soon

about.title: About the Game
about.subtitle: Get to Know Us
about.description: Deceit Online is a multiplayer Arabic game based on hidden roles, deception, alliances, and special abilities. The game is designed for groups of friends who enjoy strategy and social deduction games.
about.gameDescription: Deceit is a multiplayer social deception game. Each player gets a secret role and special ability, then tries to read others' intentions and make the right decisions before one team wins the battle.

step1.title: Get Your Secret Role
step1.description: At the start of the game, you get one secret role: either from the Kingdom (good) or from the Shadows (evil). Each role has its own special ability, like protection, killing, investigation, or sabotage.

step2.title: Use Your Ability at Night
step2.description: Every night, your role uses its ability secretly: Shadows attack, while the Kingdom protects and investigates. No one knows what you did at night, and all events are revealed during the day.

step3.title: Discuss and Vote During the Day
step3.description: During the day, discuss with players what happened, gather evidence, and spot contradictions. Then vote to kick out the player you think is from the Shadows. Beware: Shadows lie to hide their identity!

tip.title: 💡 Tips for Beginners
tip.description: The key to winning isn't just knowing the roles, but watching who talks too much, who avoids answering, and who defends certain players. Be smart in choosing who to trust!

cycle.title: Day & Night Cycle
cycle.subtitle: The Cycle of Deception
cycle.description: The game revolves in repeating cycles: night where abilities are used secretly, then day for discussion and voting.

night.title: Night
night.point1: Each character uses their ability in turn.
night.point2: Shadows secretly agree on the night's target.
night.point3: Some abilities protect, some deceive, some kill.

day.title: Day
day.point1: Players discuss what happened during the night.
day.point2: Accusations intersect with evidence and suspicions.
day.point3: Group voting decides who gets kicked out of the game.

cycle.quote: The game is not measured by knowing the roles only, but by understanding what happened in the darkness... and why it happened.

goals.title: Winning Conditions
goals.subtitle: Path to Victory
goals.description: Each team has its own path to victory. Understand your team's win condition to succeed.

kingdom.title: Kingdom Victory
kingdom.description: Eliminate all Shadow members while keeping the King alive until the end of the match.

shadows.title: Shadows Victory
shadows.description: Eliminate the King (and Crown Prince if applicable) to claim victory over the Kingdom.

neutral.title: Neutral Victory
neutral.description: Each neutral character has their own unique winning condition, independent of the main teams.

cta.title: The Throne Awaits… Who Will Rule?
cta.desc: Join the Kingdom or scheme among the Shadows — Download now.

footer.tagline: A game of lies and suspicion… trust no one.

roles.subtitle: Choose Your Allegiance
roles.title: The Roles
roles.description: Discover the characters, abilities, and hidden motives that shape every game.

King.name: King
King.desc: King, the ruler of the kingdom, decisions determine everyone's fate. Important and influential leadership role.
constraints: Cannot use any night ability.
If the king dies, the crown prince becomes the new king if alive.
If the crown prince is not alive, there is no king successor.
King's death does not automatically end the game if the crown prince is still alive.
If both king and crown prince die, the game ends with a win for the Shadows team.
King's identity is secret and not revealed to other players except via reveal or investigation abilities.
King can be voted on and executed like any other player.
King has no automatic immunity from attacks, poison, or voting.

Guard.name: Guard
Guard.desc: Protects one player from any attack during the night. Basic defensive role for the kingdom.
Guard.ability: Protects a player from the first direct killing attack during the night.
constraints: Chooses one player each night to protect.
Protection only prevents the first direct killing attack.
If the target is attacked again in the same night, protection does not prevent it.
Does not prevent poison, voting, silence, or disable abilities.
Can protect themselves.
Guard does not know if the protected player is targeted.
Can change the protected target each night.
Cannot protect more than one player in the same night.

Doctor.name: Doctor
Doctor.desc: Treats players who are injured or at risk of death. Essential for countering poison and killing abilities.
Doctor.ability: Chooses a player each night to treat from treatable attacks.
constraints: Chooses one player each night.
Treatment prevents or heals treatable attacks.
Cannot revive a player who is already dead.
Cannot prevent death caused by voting.
Doctor does not know in advance if the target is injured.
Can treat themselves.

Investigator.name: Investigator
Investigator.desc: Gathers information to reveal a player's true role. Helps discover Shadows.
Investigator.ability: Gains accurate information about a player each night, unless the player is affected by the Forger's ability.
constraints: Chooses one player each night to investigate.
Gains accurate information according to investigation system rules.
If target is affected by Forger, gets wrong result.
Does not know the result was forged.
Cannot investigate themselves.
Protection does not prevent investigation.
Can use ability multiple times during the game.
Cannot investigate a player who is already dead.

Knight.name: Knight
Knight.desc: Brave warrior defending the kingdom with strength. Possesses combat abilities and protective skills.
Knight.ability: Has a shield that protects himself or another player from a direct killing attack.
constraints: Chooses one shield each night (self or another player).
Shield blocks one direct killing attack only.
If target is attacked again, shield does not protect.
Does not protect from poison or voting.
If shield used on self, cannot use on others.
Knight does not know if shield was targeted.
Can change target each night.
Shield is consumed only if actually targeted.

Royal Guard.name: Royal Guard
Royal Guard.desc: Personal guard for the king, protects royal family members.
Royal Guard.ability: Protects the king and crown prince from direct killing attacks.
constraints: Chooses one player each night to protect.
Protection prevents one direct killing attack.
Does not protect from poison or voting.
If king dies, focus shifts automatically to crown prince.
Royal Guard does not know if target is hit.
Can also protect themselves.
Protection is consumed only if target is actually hit.

Judge.name: Judge
Judge.desc: Judges disputes and decides fate. Plays a crucial role in pivotal decisions.
Judge.ability: Must use ability before voting result is finalized; when activated, voting is canceled and no player is eliminated.
constraints: Must use ability before voting result is finalized.
When activated, voting is canceled and no player is eliminated.
Cannot re-vote on the same day due to challenge.
After use, must wait 3 days before using again.
Can use ability multiple times during the game.
Cannot use ability after voting result is announced.
Can use ability to save themselves.
Minimum uses 2, maximum 7.

Vizier.name: Vizier
Vizier.desc: King's advisor, manages kingdom affairs. Holds great influence and knowledge.
Vizier.ability: Gains accurate information about a randomly chosen player's team.
constraints: At the start of the game, the vizier receives information about a random player.
When the ability is ready again, the system selects a new random player.
Vizier only knows the team the player belongs to.
Does not know the player's identity or ability.
The information the vizier receives is always accurate.
Result is unaffected by the Forger's ability.
Can use ability multiple times during the game.
Cannot choose the player himself.
Vizier.cooldown: 5–7 players: one night | 8–11 players: two nights | 12–15 players: three nights | 16–20 players: four nights

Priest.name: Priest
Priest.desc: Guides people and performs religious rituals. May have spiritual abilities or special knowledge.
Priest.ability: Can determine if a player has been converted to another team.
constraints: Chooses one player each night.
Knows if target has been converted to another team.
Does not know original or new team.
Does not know who performed the conversion.
Can use ability multiple times.
Result is always accurate.
Unaffected by Forger's ability.

Messenger.name: Messenger
Messenger.desc: Transmits messages and secret communications between parties. Important for coordination and secret communication.
Messenger.ability: Can send a secret message to one player each night.
constraints: Chooses one player each night to send a message.
Message reaches only the target.
Messenger does not know if message was delivered.
Cannot receive messages from other players.
Message contains no sender identity.
Can use ability multiple times.

Wizard.name: Wizard
Wizard.desc: Possesses magical knowledge and mysterious abilities. Has a unique ability that can change the game's course.
Wizard.ability: Can silence one player each night, preventing them from using their ability.
constraints: Chooses one player each night to silence.
Silence prevents target from using their ability that night.
Does not prevent voting.
Wizard does not know if silence was successful.
Can silence themselves.
Can use ability multiple times.
Silence does not prevent negative abilities (e.g., poison).

Citizen.name: Citizen
Citizen.desc: Ordinary kingdom inhabitant. No special abilities, but vote is important in voting.
Citizen.ability: Has no special abilities; relies on voting.
constraints: Cannot use any night ability.
Relies only on voting.
Vote is important in voting.
Has no additional information.

Crown Prince.name: Crown Prince
Crown Prince.desc: Heir to the throne, ready to take power when the king falls.
Crown Prince.ability: If the king dies, the crown prince becomes the new king.
constraints: Transformation to king happens automatically immediately upon king's death.
No vote or approval required.
Cannot transform if already dead before the king.
After transforming into king, no longer treated as crown prince.
Crown prince's identity is as secret as the king's.
Crown prince has no night or day abilities before transforming into king.
Crown prince cannot refuse or opt out of the transformation.

Trickster.name: Trickster
Trickster.desc: A character who tries to convince players they are a threat or part of an opposing team, until eliminated by vote.
Trickster.ability: Has no direct night ability; relies on manipulation and deception to get voted out.
constraints: Wins if voted out.
Does not win if dies due to another player's ability.
Does not need to stay alive after being voted out.
Not told the identity of any other player.
Can claim to be any character or ability.
If voted out, win condition is triggered immediately.
Loses if game ends without being voted out.

Assassin.name: Assassin
Assassin.desc: Silent killer from the shadows. Can eliminate targets during the night with precise strikes.
Assassin.ability: Executes the main kill chosen by the Shadows.
constraints: Has final say in executing kill.
Can refuse proposal and choose another target.
Cannot kill if ability is disabled.
Cannot kill more than once per night.
If kill fails, ability is disabled for two nights.
Identity is secret.

Poisoner.name: Poisoner
Poisoner.desc: Master of toxins and deadly substances. Can poison players over time, causing delayed death.
Poisoner.ability: Poisons one player each night; the target dies after two nights if untreated.
constraints: Chooses one player each night to poison.
Poison kills target after two nights if untreated.
Doctor can treat poison at night or morning.

Saboteur.name: Saboteur
Saboteur.desc: Disrupts abilities and interferes with plans. Can disable key abilities at crucial moments.
Saboteur.ability: Disables one player's ability each night.
constraints: Chooses one player each night to disable.
Disables target from using their ability.
Does not prevent voting.
Saboteur does not know if disable succeeded.
Can disable themselves.
Can use ability multiple times.
Disable does not prevent negative abilities.

Deceiver.name: Deceiver
Deceiver.desc: Expert at spreading misinformation and confusion. Can manipulate perceptions and create false narratives.
Deceiver.ability: Can manipulate perceptions and create false narratives among players.
constraints: Uses deception during discussions.
Can create false narratives about roles.
Manipulates perceptions during voting.
No direct night ability.
Relies on social manipulation.

Shadow Leader.name: Shadow Leader
Shadow Leader.desc: Commands the Shadows with authority. Coordinates attacks and strategies for maximum impact.
Shadow Leader.ability: Proposes the main night kill target.
constraints: Proposal is not mandatory for the team.
Assassin has final decision on execution.
Shadow Leader does not know who the assassin is.
Shadow Leader has no direct kill ability.
Can change proposal each night.
Identity is secret like other Shadows.

Whisperer.name: Whisperer
Whisperer.desc: Communicates secretly with Shadows. Can share information without detection.
Whisperer.ability: Communicates secretly with Shadows team members.
constraints: Can share information with Shadows without detection.
Messages are private to Shadows only.
Cannot communicate with other teams.
Helps coordinate Shadow strategies.
Cannot be detected by other roles.

Spy.name: Spy
Spy.desc: Monitors a specific player and reveals interactions during the night. Helps in knowing who moves and active players.
Spy.ability: Monitors a player and knows who interacts with them during the night.
constraints: Chooses one player each night to monitor.
Knows which roles targeted the player.
Does not know player names.
Spy does not know who targeted them.
Can monitor themselves.
Monitoring is not revealed to the target.

Forger.name: Forger
Forger.desc: Corrupts investigation results, turning truth upside down. Makes investigators see false information.
Forger.ability: Chooses a player each night to corrupt investigation results against them.
constraints: Chooses one player each night to forge.
Forgery affects investigation results against target.
Investigator gets wrong result.
Forger does not know who achieved with target.
Investigator does not know result is fake.
Can forge themselves.
Forgery lasts only one night.

Impersonator.name: Impersonator
Impersonator.desc: Copies another player's ability to use for one night only. Allows temporary use of any ability.
Impersonator.ability: Copies another player's ability and uses it for one night.
constraints: Chooses one player each night to copy ability.
Uses copied ability same night.
Does not know identity of copied player.
Cannot copy abilities that cannot be copied.
Copied ability can be used once.
Can copy themselves (no benefit).
Original player does not lose their ability.

Slasher.name: Slasher
Slasher.desc: Chooses a player each night to kill. If successful, the target dies normally. If failed, Slasher's ability enters a one-night cooldown.
Slasher.ability: Kills a player directly each night.
constraints: Chooses one player each night to kill.
Kill is direct and cannot be prevented by protection.
If kill succeeds, Slasher gets additional kills.
If kill fails, ability is disabled for one night.
Doctor cannot heal Slasher's kill.
Protection or shields cannot prevent it.
He is the only one who kills and cannot be prevented.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Your privacy is important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, share, and protect your information when you use our mobile application and related services.

s1.title: 1. Information We Collect
s1.intro: We collect information to provide, maintain, and improve our gameplay experience. The types of data collected depend on how you interact with the app.

device.title: A. Device & Technical Information
device.identifiers: Device Identifiers: Device model, hardware model, operating system version, unique device identifier (UUID / Device ID), screen resolution, and system language settings.
device.network: Network Data: IP address, internet connection type, and approximate geographic location (country/city level derived from IP).
device.diagnostics: Diagnostics & Error Logs: Stack traces, crash reports, app performance metrics, and error logs collected via our internal issue logger (IssueLogger).

profile.title: B. Player Profile & Gameplay Data
profile.info: Profile Information: Player display name, chosen avatar, user preferences, and language settings.
profile.gameplay: Gameplay Data: Match statistics (wins, losses, games played), unlocked roles, achievements, in-game wallet currency/tokens balance, and session logs.
profile.cloud: Cloud & Sync Data: Multi-player room data, game lobby information, and room status stored via database services (MongoDB).

financial.title: C. Financial & Transaction Data
financial.purchases: In-App Purchases: Purchase transaction IDs, purchase history, timestamp, and entitlement status (Entitlements).
financial.note: We do not collect, process, or store credit card numbers, bank account details, or billing addresses. All payments are processed securely directly by Google Play Billing.

ads.title: D. Advertising Data
ads.identifiers: Advertising Identifiers: Google Advertising ID (GAID / IDFA).
ads.interaction: Ad Interaction Data: Ad views, clicks, and rewarded ad completion events handled by Google Mobile Ads (AdMob).

feedback.title: E. User Feedback & Support
feedback.submissions: Feedback Submissions: Message content, bug reports, and user-provided feedback submitted via in-app forms (FeedbackService).

s2.title: 2. Why We Collect Data (Purpose of Processing)
s2.intro: We collect and use your data for the following specific purposes:

table.purpose: Authenticating guest sessions, maintaining account security, preventing fraud/abuse, and enforcing anti-cheat rules.
Saving local and online progress, calculating scores, managing leaderboards, and rendering multi-player room states.
Identifying software bugs, diagnosing crashes, optimizing app performance, and maintaining system stability.
Verifying purchases, delivering virtual items/entitlements, and restoring purchases.
Displaying relevant non-personalized or personalized ads, enabling rewarded video ads, and measuring ad campaign performance.
Responding to support inquiries, resolving technical issues, and incorporating feature requests.

s3.title: 3. Data Sharing & Third-Party Services
s3.intro: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information. We only share data with trusted third-party service providers necessary to operate the application:

google.title: A. Google Play Services & Google Mobile Ads (AdMob)
google.purpose: Ad serving, advertising measurement, fraud detection, and Google Play billing processing.

mongo.title: B. Cloud Database & Infrastructure Services (MongoDB Atlas)
mongo.purpose: Securely storing online match rooms, user scores, and feedback logs.

s4.title: 4. In-App Purchases & Financial Privacy
s4.p1: All financial transactions are conducted through Google Play Store's official payment system (Google Play Billing).
s4.bullet1: We only receive cryptographic purchase tokens and transaction confirmation status to unlock purchased digital content inside the game.
s4.bullet2: We never store or request sensitive payment details.

s5.title: 5. Advertising & Choice Options
s5.intro: Our app integrates Google Mobile Ads (AdMob) to display advertisements and provide rewarded video options.
s5.nonPersonalized: Non-Personalized Ads: Depending on your consent and location, ads may be non-personalized.
s5.optOut: Opt-Out of Personalized Ads: You can reset or opt out of personalized advertising on Android devices by navigating to: Settings > Google > Ads > Reset advertising ID / Delete advertising ID.

s6.title: 6. Data Security & Storage
s6.intro: We implement standard administrative, technical, and physical security measures to protect your data:
s6.encryption: Encryption in Transit: Data transmitted between the app and cloud servers is encrypted using HTTPS / TLS.
s6.localStorage: Local Storage Security: Local configuration, game stats, and preferences are stored securely within isolated application sandbox storage (SharedPreferences).
s6.access: Access Controls: Database connections use restricted authentication credentials.

s7.title: 7. Data Retention & Deletion Rights
s7.retentionDesc: We retain player profile and gameplay data only for as long as necessary to fulfill the operational requirements of the game or as required by law.
s7.rightsTitle: B. User Data Rights & Account Deletion
s7.right1: Access the data associated with your profile.
s7.right2: Request deletion of your account and associated game data.
s7.right3: Reset local game progress via app settings or by clearing app data on your device.
s7.contactNote: To request full deletion of your remote profile and feedback logs, please submit a request to our support email with your display name or device ID.

s8.title: 8. Children's Privacy (COPPA & GDPR)
s8.content: ديسيت (DECEIT) is designed for a general audience. We do not knowingly collect or solicit personal information from children under the age of 13 (or under 16/18 in applicable jurisdictions). If we learn that we have inadvertently collected personal data from a child without parental consent, we will take steps to delete that information promptly.

s9.title: 9. Changes to This Privacy Policy
s9.content: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically to reflect changes in our practices, software features, or legal requirements. We encourage you to review this page regularly. The "Effective Date" at the top indicates when the policy was last updated.

s10.title: 10. Contact Us
s10.content: If you have any questions or concerns regarding this Privacy Policy or your data, please contact us at:
